scope: All45 clause definitions across15 mandatory feature review dimensions; exact224 source selectors and field meaning reviewed, including ingestion lifecycle distinctions, audio spectral/phase and mix ordering, video render/encode, scene/clock identity, spatial coordinate/unit/loss, generation safety/budget and localization direction/reflow.
authority: User-delegated Media product-definition coordinator ownership; source-only review
acceptanceBoundary: This approves bounded source clauses for applicability validation. It does not accept the whole P0-07 task, qualify runtimes, prove UI/assistive technology behavior, grant independent phase acceptance or issue Lifecycle evidence.

records.criterion: An upload/import must preserve a typed source identity, tenant-scoped upload session, and immutable artifact version as distinct facts.
Chunk acceptance, completion, checksum/integrity verification, and artifact availability are separate operations and dispositions.
Import and verification review must cover malformed/untrusted inputs and QUARANTINED/REJECTED results; source presence never implies usability.
Time values use exact rational media-time and sample-boundary contracts; conversions preserve explicit rounding/loss disposition.
A temporal source map records its exact frame/sample identity, timebase, ordering, and retained mapping; do not infer constant frame rate.
Wire/interchange review must preserve timebase and conversion distinctions across declared protocol projections.
Audio analysis scope includes measured loudness, peaks/clipping and spectral/phase observations with metric identity and units.
Mix/effect review preserves audio output distinction, ordered processing, and declared effect parameters rather than image/video-only semantics.
Quality and export review binds assessment to audio subject/version and preserves explicit unit, uncertainty, and evidence dispositions.
Speech processing distinguishes file and streaming transcription and speaker diarization as separate typed operations.
Transcript/caption outputs remain versioned text aligned to source media time; language and uncertainty are explicit observation facts.
Voice identity/synthesis/dubbing requires scoped current consent and provenance; processing success is not authority.
Image review binds exact image generation/analysis operations to the selected output type and quality metric subject.
Video review covers frame/timing-aware rendering, temporal quality, encoding and delivery as distinct output dispositions.
Region/keyframe/tracking edits bind to exact source version, geometry/track evidence, and produced-vs-estimated provenance.
Scene hierarchy, animation clock domains, transforms and object identity use the normative animation rule and typed time descriptors.
Simulation review binds exact initial state/model, selected domain profile, pass contract and typed result; no pass name substitutes for output semantics.

Spatial export preserves exact source geometry and identity, requires explicit target format/profile, coordinate, axis and unit contracts, and reports each conversion loss; runtime, wire and persistence projections remain separate.
Generation request binds user intent and exact selected references/parameters to a typed generation operation and output.
A declared profile/cost/provider choice is distinct from provider admission, model acquisition and qualification.
Compare/reproduce outputs only with exact input/profile/version/provenance, current rights, declared safety controls and budget.
Each assessment identifies exact metric/domain, modality, subject input or output, method/version, and applicable reference data.
Unknown, abstained, conflicting, and measured observations stay distinct; calibration/threshold claims require exact method and evidence.
The typed quality registry supplies image, video and audio metric domains; absent input/reference applicability remains NOT_APPLICABLE or UNKNOWN, not a score.
Tenant identity, data classification, processing locality and authorization are independent exact-scope constraints.
Consent/rights decisions are issuer-scoped and current; revocation denies future effects without asserting in-flight termination or recall.
Disclosure, retention, legal hold, erasure and deletion evidence use separate scoped dispositions and external-owner boundaries.
Review/comments/approval bind an exact immutable project/artifact version and actor authority; a newer version invalidates stale decisions when declared.
Comparison/impact output names exact input versions, affected scope and completeness; recommendation is not an approval.
Handoff and independently recorded decisions preserve actor/authority provenance and distinguish observation from mutation.
Job, attempt, lease/fence, progress, partial result and retry are distinct machine identities; retry is not safe solely by request label.
Cancellation requests, effect start, timeout/process death, authoritative reconciliation and terminal finality remain distinct.
Live sessions/frames have explicit sequence, acknowledgement, reconnect and producer event semantics; delivery is not inferred from event declaration.
Local draft edits and reads are distinct from provider dispatch, publication, deletion, and any durable offline command queue.
Reconnect preserves stable command/object identity and surfaces stale revisions/conflicts without overwriting newer owner state.
A disconnected or ambiguous submit remains unknown until exact authoritative receipt reconciliation; no blind replay is inferred.
Each channel binds to exact operation request/result/error/version semantics; channel names do not imply protocol equivalence.
Commands and queries are distinct from versioned domain event/notification meanings and transport delivery mechanics.
Web/CLI/API/SDK/HTTP/gRPC/integration/agent/client surfaces require exact leaf bindings and host identity; no CLI/GUI surface is fabricated.
Every interactive state/effect has keyboard equivalence, accessible programmatic state and non-color status.
Media controls have usable alternatives, status announcements and reduced-motion behavior.
Long localized strings, RTL direction, text resizing and responsive layouts preserve actions and safety information.
Every read/effect scopes host-attested tenant/principal/delegation and exact authority; caller-controlled identity cannot widen scope.
Untrusted media/parser boundaries, request bounds, quotas and effect costs require exact typed controls and deny unknown inputs.
Telemetry is minimized/redacted, model acquisition/fallback is separately gated, and crash/unknown effects require reconciliation.
